messages.subject: Stan turns 3 on August 30, 2015
parts:
Our 1.0.0 release was August 30, 2012, so Stan's about to
turn 3 in 45 days or so.

Should we have some kind of birthday party? Daniel --- any
ideas (you're our de facto event planning specialist)? Could
we grab a bar like for your birthday party a year or two back?

- Bob
